description: Make a new version of a video in a video surface. Combine any of: `remove` to take ranges OUT and keep everything else ("cut that bit", "lose the radio shot": find the exact start and end with watch_video first); `keep` to keep ONLY one span and drop the rest ("just give me 0:10 to 0:20"); `format` mp4, mov or webm; `width`/`height` to resize (give one to keep the shape); `aspect` to center-crop to 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 4:3 or 3:4; `fps`; `speed` 0.25 to 4; `mute`. All times are in the ORIGINAL video's timeline. The reply's `summary` says in words what was done ("Original 0:30.08, result 0:28.38: removed 0:16 to 0:17.70"): check it against the request. The result is added to the surface as a new video (labelled "<label> (edited)" unless you pass `label`), or replaces the original with `replace: true`. Results run up to 10 minutes and 1920px. Watch the result with `watch_video` before telling anyone it's done. Editor role required. Emits `video.updated`.

format.description: Output container. Defaults to the original's.

keep.description: The ONLY span to keep; everything outside it is dropped.

end.description: Keep until here. As a person writes it ("1:34", "1:34.5", "01:02:03") or as seconds (94).

start.description: Keep from here. As a person writes it ("1:34", "1:34.5", "01:02:03") or as seconds (94).

label.description: Label for the result. Max 60 chars.

remove.description: Ranges to take OUT; everything else stays. Up to 20, no overlaps.

end.description: Remove until here. As a person writes it ("1:34", "1:34.5", "01:02:03") or as seconds (94).

start.description: Remove from here. As a person writes it ("1:34", "1:34.5", "01:02:03") or as seconds (94).

replace.description: Replace the original video instead of adding a new one. Default false.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts bare or org-prefixed form.

speed.description: Playback speed, 0.25 to 4. Sound keeps its pitch.

surface_slug.description: Optional video surface slug. Omit for the first video surface.

video_id.description: The video's id, from list_videos. Optional when the surface holds a single video.

name: edit_video
